name: codegit
description: Lazygit-inspired power tools for VS Code's built-in Git: rewrite history from a commit list, amend older commits, manage stashes, browse the reflog.

codegit.commitLimit.description: Maximum number of commits shown in the Commits view.

codegit.reflogLimit.description: Maximum number of entries shown in the Reflog view.

codegit.confirmRewritingPushedCommits.description: Ask for confirmation before rewriting commits that are already on the upstream branch.

enumDescriptions: Always move stacked branches along (git rebase --update-refs)
codegit.updateStackedBranches.markdownDescription: When history is rewritten, also move other local branches that point at the rewritten commits, such as branches stacked on top of each other (`git rebase --update-refs`, git 2.38 or later). Branches checked out in another worktree are left alone.

enumDescriptions: Most recently checked out first (lazygit default)
codegit.branchSort.description: Order of local branches in the Branches view. The current branch is always first.

codegit.showSyncButtons.description: Show Fetch, Pull and Push buttons on the Source Control "Changes" title bar.

commands.title: Mark as Base Commit for Rebase
Set as Upstream of Current Branch
Move Changes out of Commit (to Index)

commandPalette.when: codegit.operation == rebase || codegit.operation == cherry-pick || codegit.operation == revert
